filename: Ethics in climate AI_ From theory to practice.pdf
title: Ethics in climate AI: From theory to practice
testbed_rationale: This is an opinion piece discussing ethics, explainability, documentation, and academic culture in climate AI; it does not produce or benchmark datasets.
pain_points: Regional bias and inequity arising from higher data density/quality in northern and western areas
Inequity in access to computational resources between academic institutions and large tech corporations
Brittleness and failure under climate-change-induced distribution shifts
Opacity and black-box nature of complex deep learning models
Academic incentive structures that reward short-term publication velocity and raw accuracy over interpretability, robustness, and comprehensive documentation
extraction_notes: Opinion article in PLOS Climate focusing on ethical practices and explainability in climate AI; no machine learning models were developed or evaluated.
